Geometry · Unit 9: Coordinate Geometry

Slope Review

Slope from two points, and slopes of parallel and perpendicular lines.

What you’ll learn

  • Calculate slope from two points
  • Use slopes of parallel and perpendicular lines
  • Classify figures using slope

Helps to know first: Slope and Rate of Change (Algebra 1).

The mountain biking connection

Trail grade is slope: rise over run.
